avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces alectinib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; use alternative for mood/anxiety support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer decreases alectinib levels; concurrent use contraindicated
avoid_supplements.action: Do not use; coordinate with oncology if tuberculosis treatment needed

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases alectinib exposure and toxicity risk

caution_supplements.name: Ginger
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase alectinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; use in moderation or limit to culinary amounts

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 modulation and additive hepatotoxicity risk
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor liver function tests if supplementing regularly

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases alectinib plasma concentrations and adverse event risk
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet completely; switch to other citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase alectinib absorption and peak plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Take alectinib consistently with or without food; maintain consistent dietary pattern

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, Brussels sprouts, cabbage)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contain indoles that may induce CYP3A4 at very high intake levels
caution_foods.action: Normal dietary consumption acceptable; excessive supplemental intake should be avoided

monitoring_notes: Monitor for hepatotoxicity and signs of alectinib toxicity (gastrointestinal upset, vision changes, muscle pain) as CYP3A4 interactions significantly impact drug exposure. Baseline and periodic liver function tests recommended, especially if adding CYP3A4 modulators.
